bibliographic.title: Rapina a casa Berluti
bibliographic.author: Pinellos
bibliographic.description: It is a demo-game intendeed to let the users watch the  "MMIFIF Framework" in action. MMIFIF is a subset of macros and functions for Twine, that allows making textual games with the classic verb-based visual interface typical of most graphical adventures. This is a short game also used in the MMIFIF User Manual to explain the basic concepts, so it is very simple.
